wikipedia.extract: The Antillean piculet (Nesoctites micromegas) is a species of bird in subfamily Picinae of the woodpecker family Picidae. It is endemic to the Caribbean island of Hispaniola that is shared by the Dominican Republic and Haiti.
wikipedia.title: Antillean piculet

commonNames.name: Black-and-white-casqued Hornbill
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The black-and-white-casqued hornbill (Bycanistes subcylindricus), also known as the grey-cheeked hornbill, is a large black and white hornbill. It has an oversized blackish bill with a large casque on top.
wikipedia.title: Black-and-white-casqued hornbill

wikipedia.extract: The comb-crested jacana (Irediparra gallinacea), also known as the lotusbird or lilytrotter (though these names are sometimes used to describe Jacanidae as a whole), is the only species of jacana in the genus Irediparra. Like other jacana species, it is adapted to the floating vegetation of tropical freshwater wetlands.
wikipedia.title: Comb-crested jacana

commonNames.name: Chimpanzee
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The chimpanzee (; Pan troglodytes), commonly abbreviated to chimp, is a medium-sized great ape species found in the forests and savannas of equatorial Africa. It has four confirmed subspecies and a fifth proposed one.
wikipedia.title: Chimpanzee

commonNames.name: Crossley's Dwarf Lemur
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The furry-eared dwarf lemur (Cheirogaleus crossleyi), or Crossley's dwarf lemur, only found on the island of Madagascar, as with all other lemurs. It has a pelage coloration that is red-brown dorsally and gray ventrally.
wikipedia.title: Furry-eared dwarf lemur

wikipedia.extract: The Heliornithidae are a small family of tropical birds with webbed lobes on their feet like those of grebes and coots. The family overall are known as finfoots, although one species is known as a sungrebe.
wikipedia.title: Heliornithidae

commonNames.name: Hoffmann’s Titi Monkey
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: Hoffmanns's titi monkey (Plecturocebus hoffmannsi) is a species of titi monkey, a type of New World monkey, endemic to Brazil. It was described as Callicebus hoffmannsi in 1908.
wikipedia.title: Hoffmanns's titi monkey

wikipedia.extract: The cat (Felis catus), also called domestic cat and house cat, is a small domesticated carnivorous mammal. It is a member of Felidae, the family of mammals in the order Carnivora also colloquially referred to as cats.
wikipedia.title: Cat

wikipedia.extract: Strongylocentrotus purpuratus is a species of sea urchin in the family Strongylocentrotidae, which is commonly known as the purple sea urchin or Pacific purple sea urchin. It lives along the eastern edge of the Pacific Ocean extending from Ensenada, Mexico, to British Columbia, Canada.
wikipedia.title: Strongylocentrotus purpuratus

wikipedia.extract: Callipepla is a genus of birds in the New World quail family, Odontophoridae. They are sometimes referred to as crested quails.
wikipedia.title: Callipepla

wikipedia.extract: Lophornis is a genus of hummingbird in the family Trochilidae. These are all tiny birds, ranking among the smallest hummingbirds.
wikipedia.title: Lophornis

wikipedia.extract: Ceratogymna is a genus of large, primarily frugivorous hornbills (family Bucerotidae) found in the humid forests of Central and West Africa. They are sexually dimorphic: males are all black, while females have brown heads and a smaller casque.
wikipedia.title: Ceratogymna

wikipedia.extract: Loons (North American English) or divers (British / Irish English) are a group of aquatic birds found in much of North America and northern Eurasia. All living species of loons are members of the genus Gavia, family Gaviidae, and order Gaviiformes.
wikipedia.title: Loon

wikipedia.extract: Zoonavena is a genus of swift in the family Apodidae.
wikipedia.title: Zoonavena

commonNames.name: Daraina Sportive Lemur
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

gbif.scientificName: Lepilemur milanoii Louis Jr., Engberg, Lei, Geng, Sommer, Randriamampionona, Randriamanana, Zaonarivelo et al., 2006

wikipedia.extract: The Daraina sportive lemur (Lepilemur milanoii) is a sportive lemur endemic to Madagascar. It is a relatively small sportive lemur with a total length of about 49 to 56 cm (19 to 22 in), of which 24–27 cm (9.4–10.6 in) are tail.
wikipedia.title: Daraina sportive lemur

commonNames.name: Black-handed Titi
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The coastal black-handed titi monkey (Callicebus melanochir) is a species of titi, a type of New World monkey, endemic to Brazil.
wikipedia.title: Coastal black-handed titi monkey

wikipedia.extract: The Azuero spider monkey (Ateles geoffroyi azuerensis) is a possible subspecies of spider monkey that is in critical danger of extinction according to the IUCN Red List of Threatened Species. Common names of this subspecies include mono charro, mono charao and mono araña.
wikipedia.title: Azuero spider monkey
